data.content: In which sites was Iomeprol found to be a risk driver in France in 2010?

args.query: List all sampling sites in France where the substance Iomeprol has an IS_DRIVER relationship in the year 2010. Include the site names, site IDs, and the specific 2010 quarter(s) when Iomeprol was marked as a driver.

data.content:
No data was found for the following cypher: MATCH (s:Substance)-[d:IS_DRIVER]->(site:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Iomeprol'
  AND site.country = 'France'
  AND d.year = 2010
RETURN site.name AS SiteName,
       id(site) AS SiteID,
       collect(DISTINCT d.quarter) AS Quarters2010
ORDER BY SiteName
